name: ClickHouse server health
description: Query and insert rates, memory, merges, parts per partition, replication lag, errors, disks and the slowest queries of the last hour.

dashboard.name: ClickHouse server health
dashboard.description: Server health from the system tables. Panels that read system.metric_log need it enabled (the default).

variables.name: database
variables.label: Database
variables.query: SELECT name FROM system.databases WHERE name NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema') ORDER BY name

panels.name: Running queries
panels.query: SELECT count() AS running FROM system.processes

panels.name: Memory in use
panels.query: SELECT toUInt64(anyIf(value, metric = 'MemoryResident')) AS memory FROM system.asynchronous_metrics

panels.name: Running merges
panels.query: SELECT count() AS merges FROM system.merges

panels.name: Max replica lag (s)
panels.query: SELECT max(absolute_delay) AS lag_s FROM system.replicas

panels.name: Queries per second
panels.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval second) AS ts,
  round(sum(ProfileEvent_Query) / $__interval, 3) AS queries_per_s,
  round(sum(ProfileEvent_SelectQuery) / $__interval, 3) AS selects_per_s
FROM system.metric_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts WITH FILL
  FROM toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv($__timeFrom, 1000)), INTERVAL $__interval second)
  TO toDateTime(intDiv($__timeTo, 1000))
  STEP $__interval

panels.name: Inserts per second
panels.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval second) AS ts,
  round(sum(ProfileEvent_InsertQuery) / $__interval, 3) AS inserts_per_s,
  round(sum(ProfileEvent_InsertedRows) / $__interval, 1) AS rows_per_s
FROM system.metric_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts WITH FILL
  FROM toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv($__timeFrom, 1000)), INTERVAL $__interval second)
  TO toDateTime(intDiv($__timeTo, 1000))
  STEP $__interval

panels.name: Memory tracked (MB)
panels.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval second) AS ts,
  round(max(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking) / 1048576, 1) AS memory_mb
FROM system.metric_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts WITH FILL
  FROM toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv($__timeFrom, 1000)), INTERVAL $__interval second)
  TO toDateTime(intDiv($__timeTo, 1000))
  STEP $__interval

panels.name: Merges
panels.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval second) AS ts,
  max(CurrentMetric_Merge) AS running_merges,
  round(sum(ProfileEvent_MergedRows) / $__interval, 1) AS merged_rows_per_s
FROM system.metric_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts WITH FILL
  FROM toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv($__timeFrom, 1000)), INTERVAL $__interval second)
  TO toDateTime(intDiv($__timeTo, 1000))
  STEP $__interval

panels.name: Parts per partition (top tables)
panels.description: Many parts in one partition slow down queries and merges.
panels.query:
SELECT
  database,
  table,
  partition,
  count() AS parts,
  sum(rows) AS rows,
  formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS size
FROM system.parts
WHERE active AND database IN (${database})
GROUP BY database, table, partition
ORDER BY parts DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.name: Replication lag
panels.description: Empty when no table is replicated.
panels.query:
SELECT
  database,
  table,
  absolute_delay AS lag_s,
  queue_size,
  inserts_in_queue,
  merges_in_queue,
  is_readonly,
  is_session_expired
FROM system.replicas
WHERE database IN (${database})
ORDER BY absolute_delay DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.name: Errors
panels.description: Error counters since the server started.
panels.query:
SELECT
  name,
  code,
  value AS count,
  last_error_time,
  left(last_error_message, 200) AS last_message,
  remote
FROM system.errors
ORDER BY last_error_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.name: Disk usage
panels.query:
SELECT
  name,
  path,
  type,
  formatReadableSize(total_space - free_space) AS used,
  formatReadableSize(total_space) AS total,
  round(100 * (1 - free_space / total_space), 1) AS used_pct
FROM system.disks
ORDER BY used_pct DESC

panels.name: Slowest queries (last hour)
panels.query:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user,
  query_duration_ms,
  read_rows,
  formatReadableSize(read_bytes) AS read,
  formatReadableSize(memory_usage) AS memory,
  left(query, 200) AS query
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND event_date >= yesterday()
  AND event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
ORDER BY query_duration_ms DESC
LIMIT 20
